text: In the context of the instrumental and non-instrumental, I shall first explain the instrumental (such as dharma) and the non-instrumental (such as upward movement). In this connection, just as a king in his own kingdom does whatever he desires by virtue of his sovereignty, similarly, Nature (Pradhana), by virtue of its omnipresence everywhere, operates the instrumental and non-instrumental aspects. It arranges the seed (linga) for the sustaining of separate bodies.
